rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Origin
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Source at which something begins or rises, or from which something derives.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Internal identifier
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Term or code that identifies someone or something within a particular product.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Studied state
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Reference to a point in time at which something or someone was studied in a particular mode or condition.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Type
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Distinct class to which a group of entities or concepts with similar characteristics or attributes belong to.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Laterality
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Differentiation between a pair of lateral homologous parts of the body.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Species
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Category of biological classification comprising related organisms or populations potentially capable of interbreeding, and being designated by a binomial that consists of the name of a genus followed by a Latin or latinized uncapitalized noun or adjective.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Is part of
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Reference to the ensemble of multiple things or beings.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Biological sex
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Differentiation of individuals of most species (animals and plants) based on the type of gametes they produce.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Tissue sample
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Structured information on a tissue sample.
